title: Mouse Without Borders fails to pair: "Could not load or update pairing" (Negotiation → Connecting → Error)

judgment.rationale: Preserve needs_information and the low-confidence branch-attribution direction, but expand the prior transport-only emphasis: the generic pairing message also covers local Settings-to-worker IPC/key operations. comment.body: Thanks for the detailed controls and both 0.102.3001 confirmations. Please do not repeat the firewall, matching-key, IP-mapping, VPN, administrator, or restart tests already recorded. The unresolved point is whether the first failure is local pairing/IPC or the cross-PC connection. Could you make one connection attempt, note its time, then comment /bugreport and attach the resulting reports from both PCs immediately after that same failure? If Settings or the tray is unavailable, run BugReportTool.exe from each PowerToys installation directory. Please do not post the security key itself.
